name: Alpha diversity
description: Within-sample diversity from a long taxon profile table: richness, Shannon, Simpson and Pielou evenness per sample after artifact removal and renormalisation. Draws the chosen index per group and over the study timeline, and tests groups (Kruskal-Wallis) and time trends (Spearman) with Benjamini-Hochberg control.

inputs.label: Taxon profiles (long)
inputs.description: One row per taxon per sample with read counts. Group, subject and timepoint roles add the comparisons and the time plot.

metric.title: Index to draw
metric.description: Which index the figures show; the table always has all four.

rank.title: Taxonomic rank
rank.description: When the table maps a rank role, use taxa of this rank only.

min_reads.title: Minimum reads per sample
min_reads.description: Samples with fewer retained reads are dropped; 0 keeps every sample.

remove_artifacts.title: Remove curated artifacts
remove_artifacts.description: Drop taxa on curation lists with the artifact role before computing the indices.

outputs.name: alpha_diversity
outputs.description: One row per sample: richness, Shannon, Simpson, evenness, reads, plus group, subject and timepoint.

outputs.name: alpha_tests
outputs.description: Kruskal-Wallis across groups and Spearman against time, per index, with BH q-values.

outputs.name: alpha_by_group
outputs.description: The chosen index per group as box plots with every sample.

outputs.name: alpha_over_time
outputs.description: The chosen index against the timepoint, coloured by group, with a running median per group.

citation: Built with pandas, NumPy, SciPy (Virtanen et al. 2020) and Plotly. Shannon uses the natural logarithm; Pielou evenness J = H / ln(S); the test layout follows the INDIVO Explorer temporal-trends page. See README.md for details.
